Static Translations is currently feature flagged and only available in Events. If you would like to use it, please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} with your Org ID to have it turned on. ::: Similar to the functionality of the Data Dictionary override capability, Static Translations (Beta) allows Event Planners to override or write their own Translations instead of using Google Translate's auto-translation. ## Objects and Fields Available for Translation ### Object: Event {{snippet.Translation_AvailEventFields}} ### Object: Event Item {{snippet.Translation_AvailEVItemFields}} ### Object: Session {{snippet.Translation_AvailSessionFields}} ### Object: Form {{snippet.Translation_AvailFormFields}} ### Object: Form Element {{snippet.Translation_AvailFormEleFields}} ### Object: Form Element Condition {{snippet.Translation_AvailFormElCoField}} ### Object: Form Big List Option {{snippet.Translation_AvailFmBigLiOField}} ### Object: Speaker {{snippet.Translation_AvailSpeakerFields}} ### Object: Sponsor {{snippet.Translation_AvailSponsorField}} ### Object: Track {{snippet.Translation_AvailTrackField}} ### Object: Custom Content {{snippet.Translation_AvailCustEVTaField}} ### Object: Event Content {{snippet.Translation_AvailEVContenField}} ### Object: Event FAQ {{snippet.Translation_AvailEventFAQField}} ### Object: FAQ Category {{snippet.Translation_AvailFAQCategField}} ### Object: FAQ Question {{snippet.Translation_AvailFAQQuestField}} ### Object: Keyword {{snippet.Translation_AvailKeywordField}} ## Translation Object Page Layout {{snippet.TranslationObject_PageLayout}} Click [here](/v1/docs/translations-multi-language-events) for more information about how to use Static Translations (Beta).
